about: Open-source templates imported into the website designer (feat/site-v2). scripts/dev/site-gallery.py converts each page with app/ui/siteimport.js into a block config in app/ui/sitetpl/<id>.json. Only MIT and CC BY 3.0 sources; CC BY ones carry a credit line in every export (cfg.credit). Pictures are replaced with original flat art; fonts are mapped to our OFL families.
